integratedBehavior: The Tauri host creates a fresh 256-bit capability for every launch, transfers it through the supervised private control channel, retains only its digest in Core framework state, uses it only on exact loopback requests, and clears mutable startup records on valid and invalid paths.

The renderer consumes generated versioned contracts through a strict native allowlist; incompatible Core versions reach functional repair/reinstall guidance, hostile status/media/schema envelopes fail closed, and the UI reference remains design/conformance material rather than the product application.

Operation listing, status, cancellation and SSE progress use canonical identities, monotonic sequences, exact preconditions and idempotency fingerprints. Retention is bounded to 256 events and stale consumers receive an explicit replay-gap response requiring authoritative status reconciliation.

Diagnostics show only bounded allowlisted values. The researcher reviews the exact support JSON bytes whose length and SHA-256 are recomputed by the renderer; export is single-use, path-confined, redacted, and trace-linked without project content, raw credentials, absolute paths, or process identifiers.

On the measured Windows x64 workstation, compatibility and health requests through the real native authenticated boundary are approximately one millisecond p95 after readiness, with an absolute 100 ms budget and a 20-percent future regression threshold.
